state_paths.selector: path.state, path[class*='state'], path.feature, path[class*='feature'], path[class*='region'], path[class*='country'], g.states > path, g[class*='states'] > path, g[class*='features'] > path, svg > g > path
state_paths.note: 50 US states; min=45 tolerates Alaska/Hawaii omitted or handled separately; max=60 allows mesh/boundary paths alongside fills.

legend.note: Color scale legend expected. defs linearGradient covers gradient-bar implementations.

tooltip.note: Tooltip element (often a div overlaid on the SVG) must exist in DOM.

hover.trigger: path.state, path.feature, path[class*='state'], path[class*='feature'], g.states > path, g[class*='features'] > path, svg > g > path
hover.note: Mouseenter on a state path populates the tooltip; checked via tooltip innerHTML length diff. .last targets the last (top-most painted) state path.

notes: state_paths selector is broad because d3.geoPath implementations vary in element class naming conventions.
svg > g > path last-resort selector catches implementations that apply no class to geo paths.
Alaska and Hawaii are often omitted by simpler builds; min=45 tolerates this.
Tooltip may be an HTML div overlaid on the SVG container rather than an SVG element; the selector covers both.
